contact.department: Waukesha County Land Resources and Environment

counties.notes: Waukesha County (Milwaukee metro west, county seat Waukesha) exposes Web_Tax_Parcel/FeatureServer with 7 layers; layer 2 (Parcels) is the polygon tax parcel layer. Fields include TAXKEY, OWNERNAMEFULL (concatenated), OWNERNME1, OWNERNME2, SITEADRESS, ZIPCODE, TAXROLLYEAR, PLACENAME, PSTLADRESS, MUNI, PROPCLASS, AUXCLASS, SCHOOLDISTNO, LNDVALUE, IMPVALUE, CNTASSDVALUE, ESTFMKVALUE, GRSPRPTA, NETPRPTA, GISAcres. Query confirmed live: UPPER(OWNERNAMEFULL) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results (e.g., 'KENNETH H SMITH AND SUSAN A SMITH' at '17792 W JACOBS DR'). maxRecordCount 2000. The Web_Tax_Parcel FeatureServer layer 0 is Civil Divisions (municipalities), layer 1 is SimultaneousConveyance, layer 2 is the full parcel polygon with ownership data. Wisconsin uses a WIDORCODE (Wisconsin Department of Revenue code) for municipality identification alongside the standard FIPS.

Brown County, Wisconsin (Green Bay metro, county seat Green Bay; FIPS 55009). The Land Information Office moved its GIS to a new ArcGIS Server (12.1) at bcgis.browncountywi.gov; the old host gis.browncountywi.gov answered HTTP 503 on every path on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10, and the county's BrownDog 2.0 viewer (published 2026-10-30) reads the new one. The record uses Parcels/ParcelPolygons MapServer layer 20 'TaxParcel' (layer 10 'TaxParcel-smallScale' draws the same parcels at small scales; ParcelFeatures FeatureServer/0 holds the same 106,229 rows). Read 2026-11-10: 106,229 parcels; OwnerNme1 and Location non-blank on 105,860; UPPER(OwnerNme1) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 378, the sample query's predicate. The schema changed with the move: names are now mixed case (ParcelID, OwnerNme1, OwnerNme2, PstlAdress, Location), and the old SITEADRESS and Municipality columns are gone. Location is the site address with ZIP+4 ('1007 COUNTRYSIDE DR DEPERE 54115 1834'), PstlAdress a postal address line, Inc_Muni the municipality (25 names, e.g. 'City of De Pere'), and OwnMail1-4 with OwnCity, OwnState and OwnZIP5 the owner mailing block. CONFIDENTIAL OWNERS: a Confidential column is 1 on 320 rows, and on those the county itself publishes 'NOT AVAILABLE' in OwnerNme1, OwnerNme2, OwnMail1 and PstlAdress, which the atlas reads as no owner. The record registers Confidential as its confidential-owner flag (1 is confidential, 0 is not; as of 2026-11-10, 105,909 rows held 0, 320 held 1 and none was NULL), so those rows stay without an owner if the county stops masking them. maxRecordCount 10000 with pagination, native WKID 103404, CORS reflects the caller's Origin. Service copyright 'Brown County WI'; its description reads 'ParcelPolygons contains tax parcel boundaries with many attributes including land owner name.'

contact.department: Racine County Real Property Listing (Register of Deeds)

counties.notes: Racine County, Wisconsin (Racine; FIPS 55101). The county's own ArcGIS Enterprise server (arcgis.racinecounty.com), DataPortal/Parcels_NAD83_2011_STATEPLANE FeatureServer layer 0, named 'Racine County Tax Parcels_NAD_1983_2011_StatePlane_Wisconsin_South_FIPS_4803': 84,684 parcels, county-only, so no scope clause is needed. A MapServer of the same name sits beside it, and search results show a mirror on arcgis.racinecounty.gov that was not tested; the .com FeatureServer is the one verified. The parcel id is PARCELID (also LOWPARCELID and PIN12); the owner is OWNERNME1 with OWNERNME2 (82,755 of 84,684 rows populated, 97.7%; the roughly 1,900 rows with no owner are probably road, right-of-way and unassessed parcels, not verified); CNVYNAME is the conveyance (grantee) name and not the current owner; the situs is SITEADDRESS (82,763 populated); the owner mailing address is PSTLADDRESS with PSTLCITY, PSTLSTATE, PSTLZIP5 and PSTLZIP4 (82,760 populated). Also carried: CLASSCD, USECD, ZONING, CNTASSDVAL and FAIRMKTVAL. maxRecordCount is 1,000 with pagination (resultOffset works and exceededTransferLimit is set on a full page). CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Capabilities are Query and Extract only. Currency: the newest LASTUPDATE is 2026-10-11 (read 2026-10-12), 54 rows were updated on or after 2026-09-01, and the service text says the layer updates nightly. A search for SMITH on OWNERNME1 matches 396 parcels. The county's Real Property Listing page (racinecounty.gov/departments/register-of-deeds/real-property-listing) returned HTTP 403 to a scripted fetch, so the license terms were not read; the Land Description office is listed at 262-636-3548 (730 Wisconsin Ave, Racine WI 53403). The statewide Wisconsin parcel layer was not needed and not tested.
